files.exclude.markdownDescription: Configure [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_advanced-search-options) for excluding files and folders. Extensions' workspace file searches leave these out.

anyOf.description: The glob pattern to match file paths against. Set to true or false to enable or disable the pattern.

when.markdownDescription: Additional check on the siblings of a matching file. Use `$(basename)` as variable for the matching file name.

files.watcherExclude.markdownDescription: Configure [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_advanced-search-options) of file paths to exclude from file watching. Paths that change often, such as build output, are best left out to limit the watchers registered.

enumDescriptions: An editor with changes is never automatically saved.
An editor with changes is automatically saved after the configured `files.autoSaveDelay`.
An editor with changes is automatically saved when the editor loses focus.
An editor with changes is automatically saved when the window loses focus.
files.autoSave.markdownDescription: Controls auto save of editors that have unsaved changes. Unlike VS Code, which defaults to `off`, CodeBridge saves after `files.autoSaveDelay` unless told otherwise, so extensions that read files from disk see current text. `onFocusChange` and `onWindowChange` leave saving to the IDE, as `off` does.

files.autoSaveDelay.markdownDescription: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which an editor with unsaved changes is saved automatically. Only applies when `files.autoSave` is set to `afterDelay`.

editor.formatOnType.markdownDescription: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the line after typing, by asking an extension's on-type formatter when one of the characters it names is typed.

editor.linkedEditing.markdownDescription: Controls whether the editor has linked editing enabled. Depending on the language, related symbols such as HTML tags are updated while editing, as an extension's linked editing range provider says.

search.exclude.markdownDescription: Configure [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_advanced-search-options) for excluding files and folders in searches, in addition to `files.exclude`. Folders matched are excluded from the project, so the IDE neither indexes nor searches them.

anyOf.description: The glob pattern to match file paths against. Set to true or false to enable or disable the pattern.

when.markdownDescription: Additional check on the siblings of a matching file. Use `$(basename)` as variable for the matching file name.

search.useIgnoreFiles.markdownDescription: Controls whether to use `.gitignore` and `.ignore` files when searching. Folders they ignore, such as build output, are excluded from the project, so the IDE neither indexes nor searches them.
